status: Empty. No authorized first-party report has been imported.
rule: Add a row only from an authorized first-party report (for example an Associates report exported by the account owner). Each row needs its timestamp, source, provenance URL or file reference, and the report date range. No conversion score or revenue forecast is shown.

columns.name: source
columns.meaning: Name of the authorized first-party report or export.

columns.name: provenance
columns.meaning: File name or URL of the report, kept with the row.

columns.name: channel
columns.meaning: Site section or tracking ID (for example shopnow047c-20).

columns.name: eligible_sessions
columns.meaning: Sessions reported as eligible in the source report. Left blank if not reported.

columns.name: clicks
columns.meaning: Clicks as reported in the source. Left blank if not reported.

columns.name: reported_orders
columns.meaning: Orders as reported in the source. Left blank if not reported.
